method: a read-only count over the fleet's Postgres task queue on 2026-11-18: tasks = queued work items created since the first one on 2026-06-10; runs = attempts, a task retried counts once per attempt
note: No failure rate is given: the queue stores no reason for a failure, so a hard-failure rate cannot be derived from it. No agent count is given on public text.

commits.method: GitHub's own history of each code repository's default branch, read-only on 2026-11-18; commits with a commit date from 2026-05-18; the best seven days as a rolling window over Berlin calendar days. The organisation's knowledge-base repository (notes and logs, written mostly by agents) is not counted, so these are commits to code repositories only.
